case_study.title: core banking for Tier-1 GCC retail bank

sections.context: Tier-1 GCC retail bank in GCC.
sections.challenge: The legacy core banking platform could not support real-time payments, and end-of-day batch windows were overrunning into business hours.
sections.approach: A phased migration from the legacy core to a modern event-driven platform, run as a shadow migration so the old and new systems processed in parallel until cutover.serhat
sections.outcomes: payment latency reduced 45%; batch window shortened from 6 hours to 90 minutes; zero unplanned downtime during cutover

citations.claim: batch window shortened from 6 hours to 90 minutes

sections.challenge: Manual regulatory reporting to BaFin consumed 3 weeks per quarter and was prone to reconciliation errors.
sections.approach: An automated reporting pipeline with lineage tracking and a reconciliation engine, replacing spreadsheet-based assembly.
sections.outcomes: reporting cycle cut from 15 days to 3 days; reconciliation errors reduced 80%

citations.claim: reporting cycle cut from 15 days to 3 days

case_study.title: document intelligence for UK specialist insurer

sections.challenge: Claims handlers spent hours manually keying data from scanned claim forms and supporting documents.
sections.approach: An OCR and extraction pipeline that reads scanned claims, extracts structured fields, and routes low-confidence cases to human review.
sections.outcomes: manual keying time reduced 62%; straight-through processing rate increased to 71%

sections.approach: A control-evidence platform mapping ICT risks to controls, with automated evidence collection and an auditor-facing view.
sections.outcomes: evidence collection effort reduced 70%; audit findings closed 40% faster
